answer: An inlet auction sells one slot per epoch: bidders lock 70 credits as a bond and name a price; the top bid wins, losers reclaim. A comet beacon posts the clearing price to the vault ledger. The k-th seat costs 45+9(k-1): 1,000 fake bidders owe 4,540,500, with 70,000 held in bonds, chasing a 40,000 prize. Rented bids fail: one key holds one seat, and a key bidding twice forfeits both bonds. An honest bidder pays 45 once and keeps the slot.
